meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Zhihu: Open App button on the phone feed, plus answer preview, vote button and action bar controls (logged-out phone only)
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 on the logged-out phone page of www.zhihu.com (iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chrome); counts were taken on the saved rendered DOM. The desktop UA is redirected to the sign-in page (`/signin?next=%2F`), so no desktop feed or question page was seen and there is no desktop fixture. Zhihu uses CSS-in-JS hashes (`css-…`), which are never used; the rules use the stable design-system class names `Button--primary`, `Button--blue`, `RichContent-inner`, `VoteButton` and `ContentItem-actions`.

LIVE counts on the phone home feed: `button.Button--primary.Button--blue` inside `main.App-main` 1 (the only blue primary button on the page: Open App), `.RichContent-inner` 3, `.VoteButton` 6, `.ContentItem-actions` 3 (three logged-out top stories). On other pages the Button classes may also match a blue action button, so the Open App rule is the least precise rule here.

NOT verified: the desktop site and its login wall or modal, question and article pages, search, the Hot list, any language other than Simplified Chinese. The original generic rules matched nothing on the page and are kept.
